chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.local.tokens.by.day
chart.title: Tokens per day, by agent (local)
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(s.total_tokens) AS tokens, DATE_TRUNC('day', s.request_date_time) AS day, COALESCE(s.agent_role, 'unknown') AS agent FROM aiaccountant_ai_usage_stat s WHERE s.request_date_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', s.request_date_time), s.agent_role ORDER BY day

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.local.requests.by.day
chart.title: Requests per day, by agent (local)
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests, DATE_TRUNC('day', s.request_date_time) AS day, COALESCE(s.agent_role, 'unknown') AS agent FROM aiaccountant_ai_usage_stat s WHERE s.request_date_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', s.request_date_time), s.agent_role ORDER BY day

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.local.tokens.by.caller
chart.title: Tokens by caller (local, 30d)
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(s.total_tokens) AS tokens, COALESCE(s.caller, 'unknown') AS caller FROM aiaccountant_ai_usage_stat s WHERE s.request_date_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY s.caller ORDER BY tokens DESC

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.local.outcomes
chart.title: Request outcomes (local, 30d)
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests, COALESCE(s.outcome, 'unknown') AS outcome FROM aiaccountant_ai_usage_stat s WHERE s.request_date_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY s.outcome ORDER BY requests DESC

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.local.tokens.by.company
chart.title: Tokens by company (local, 30d)
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(s.total_tokens) AS tokens, COALESCE(s.company_label, 'unattributed') AS company FROM aiaccountant_ai_usage_stat s WHERE s.request_date_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY s.company_label ORDER BY tokens DESC

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.azure.tokens.last24h
chart.title: Azure metrics, last 24 hours
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(m.metric_value) AS value, TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('hour', m.bucket_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS hour, m.metric_name AS metric FROM aiaccountant_ai_azure_metric_snapshot m WHERE m.interval_grain = 'PT1H' AND m.bucket_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', m.bucket_timestamp), m.metric_name ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', m.bucket_timestamp)

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.azure.tokens.30d
chart.title: Azure metrics, last 30 days
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(m.metric_value) AS value, DATE_TRUNC('day', m.bucket_timestamp) AS day, m.metric_name AS metric FROM aiaccountant_ai_azure_metric_snapshot m WHERE m.interval_grain = 'P1D' AND m.bucket_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', m.bucket_timestamp), m.metric_name ORDER BY day

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.azure.tokens.7d
chart.title: Azure metrics, last 7 days
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(m.metric_value) AS value, DATE_TRUNC('day', m.bucket_timestamp) AS day, m.metric_name AS metric FROM aiaccountant_ai_azure_metric_snapshot m WHERE m.interval_grain = 'P1D' AND m.bucket_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', m.bucket_timestamp), m.metric_name ORDER BY day

chart.name: chart.ai.accountant.azure.tokens.by.deployment
chart.title: Azure tokens by deployment (30d)
chart.dataset: SELECT SUM(m.metric_value) AS value, COALESCE(m.model_deployment_name, 'not reported') AS deployment, m.metric_name AS metric FROM aiaccountant_ai_azure_metric_snapshot m WHERE m.interval_grain = 'P1D' AND m.metric_name IN ('ProcessedPromptTokens', 'GeneratedTokens') AND m.bucket_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY m.model_deployment_name, m.metric_name ORDER BY value DESC
